title: A33 remediation 2 — purge families for replacement, account deletion and download revocation; purge retry with backoff
verdict: NOT FLIPPED — code change only; the edge-simulator re-run that would flip INT-10 is slice 3
scope: vidra-core code + docs, this repo's evidence, and vidra-user's generated contract. No live stack, no container runtime, no browser.

migration.name: cdn_purge_jobs
migration.shape: account_exports (0057): pending -> running -> done | failed, attempts/next_attempt_at/last_error, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
migration.difference_from_0057: next_attempt_at IS the lease, so the claim admits 'running' as well as 'pending' and a worker killed mid-walk has its row reclaimed when the lease passes — no separate recovery sweep

families.snapshot: none needed — the served URL does not move, so the path is a pure function of the video id
families.purge: immediate detached pass on /api/v1/videos/{id}/thumbnail; refusals persisted for retry
families.seam: video.Service WithMediaReplacedHook, fenced on public AND published

families.trigger: video.Service.GenerateStoryboard — the publish path, ReplaceSource, and internal/storyboardbackfill's worker
families.purge: immediate detached pass on /api/v1/videos/{id}/storyboard.jpg; refusals persisted for retry
families.seam: the same service hook; a handler-level call would have missed the backfill worker, which runs where httpapi.Server is never constructed (VIDRA_ROLE=worker)

families.snapshot: accountEdgePurgePaths BEFORE the cascade: every video of every owned channel through the same videoEdgePurgeSnapshot the per-video delete uses, plus each channel's and the account's avatar/banner
families.purge: one queued job (reason=account_delete) after the cascade commits — a queue rather than a goroutine so a large catalogue survives a restart and shows on /admin/jobs

families.trigger: PATCH /admin/instance-settings {"downloads_enabled": false}, only when the gate was OPEN before the write
families.snapshot: derived per page from the catalogue rather than materialised up front
families.purge: one leased, resumable queue job with a persisted cursor_video_id; per video the same URL set videoDownloadPurgeSnapshot names, rebuilt from one row (ListVideoDownloadFacts)
families.walk_semantics: the cursor advances even when a batch had refusals; those refusals become their own retry job, and url_set_complete records the incompleteness

image_url_ruling.decision: purge the stable URL; do NOT stamp ?v= on image URLs
reasons: slice 1's header table gives thumbnail/storyboard max-age=300 must-revalidate on both sides, so a purge closes the whole window — unlike an HLS child, where ?v= is load-bearing because the entry lives a year

/videos/{id}/thumbnail is the URL the frontend, feeds, oEmbed, ActivityPub and every share link already name; the untagged URL would keep being requested and would still need purging, so a tag buys nothing and costs compatibility
avatar, banner and playlist cover already invalidate a stable URL; a fourth family with a different mechanism would be two answers to one question

retry.dead_letter: state='failed' with the unpurged URL list KEPT — it is the operator's manual-invalidation to-do list
retry.success_clears: CompleteCDNPurgeJob empties urls and sets state='done'
retry.partial_success: the urls column is rewritten to only what is still unpurged, so a retry never re-issues an accepted call
retry.operator_expectation: a transient edge failure self-heals within about two hours; anything that has not is dead-lettered, nothing tries again, and the edge keeps the object until a TTL Vidra does not set

operator_surface.admin_jobs: cdn_purge_jobs is an eighth jobstatus queue — depth, oldest-pending age, and dead letters in the merged failures list (job id and a status summary only, never a URL)

vidra_doctor.warn_on_dead_letter: says nothing will try again; fix points at manual invalidation and DELIVERY_CDN_PURGE_URL/_METHOD/_TOKEN
vidra_doctor.pass_when_pre_0137: a database without the table is OK, not a skip — nothing can be pending

operator_surface.not_rendered: vidra-user's AdminSystemStatusView ignores the three new fields; bounded follow-up

closed_entries_kept_as_notes: same-generation admin re-transcode (closed by 0136 in slice 1)
url_set_complete_causes: the storage backend cannot list, or a listing failed
the per-video fan-out cap was hit
a superseded generation is still in the store
account family: a channel or video listing failed mid-snapshot
walk: a batch had an unreadable row or a refused URL

residuals.why: the tag is the promoted playlist's own updated_at and is not recorded once the row moves on; keeping it would need a new column written on every promotion and would still be wrong for a video promoted twice (one previous tag, N superseded generations)
residuals.operator_remedy: the URLs stop existing when media GC collects the generation (MEDIA_GC_ENABLED); until then any takedown of that video reports url_set_complete=false

residuals.case: a channel handle rename strands /api/v1/channels/<old>/avatar and /banner
residuals.status: residual, not fixed — surgical but out of this slice's four families
residuals.operator_remedy: invalidate those two URLs by hand at the provider after renaming a channel on a CDN-fronted instance; now documented in vidra-core docs/operations.md
residuals.follow_up: a fifth purge trigger at the rename handler, snapshotting the old handle's URLs before the write

residuals.case: INT-10 clause (4) — no fallback to the api proxy when the edge 5xxs after a 307
residuals.status: untouched by this slice and still open
residuals.why: the resolver's fail-open discipline covers building a source, not a viewer's fetch failing afterwards; the api cannot learn about the latter
